annotations.title: Get the changes since a date

description: What the site published since a date, latest first: every snapshot published (a new report of a company, or its figures built again) with its time of publication, every record that the findings ledgers wrote for those snapshots (a finding stated for the first time, confirmed, strengthened, weakened or retired, each a sentence with its rule, period and document ids) and every correction by Annalist. Without company the answer covers the coverage over the last 90 days; with company it reads the whole record of that company. The feeds in Atom, /feed.xml and /company/{id}/feed.xml, carry the same entries for a reader that polls.

company.description: company id from search_companies, to read the whole record of one company

module.description: keep the finding records of one module

since.description: an ISO date (2026-11-01) or time (2026-11-01T06:00:00+00:00), UTC, from which changes count

states.description: keep the finding records of these states

name: get_changes_since
title: Get the changes since a date
